---
name: requirements-analysis
description: Turn OddlyFound requests into scoped, testable requirements with explicit assumptions and acceptance criteria.
---
# Requirements Analysis
- Initialize Caveman first.
- Preserve the original request; distinguish facts, assumptions, and recommendations.
- Inspect relevant files only. Do not modify application code during requirements intake.
- Define objective, functional and non-functional requirements, scope, exclusions, dependencies, edge cases, failure behavior, and acceptance criteria.
- Criteria must be observable, testable, and traceable to requirements.
- Consider responsive behavior, accessibility, SEO, performance, security, privacy, and cost when relevant.
- Initial OddlyFound scope: product discovery, collections, editorial content, affiliate links/disclosures, CMS, search/filtering, SEO, and static deployment.
- Cart, checkout, payments, accounts, inventory, order management, and custom backend are excluded unless approved.
- Do not assume the proposed stack is installed; inspect the repository.
- Gate A: obtain approval of the exact specification before planning.
